spanish: Cuadrado fue, doblado; hicieron el joshen: palmo su largo y palmo su ancho, doblado.

findings.issue: joshen leaves the common noun הַחֹשֶׁן untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish

notes: The other clauses keep 3ms fue, 3cp hicieron, both doubled participles, and the two span measures with their 3ms suffixes.
